narration: Meet Impo, your open-source personal agent. Remember what matters, get things done, and find your next good buy.
Looking for a commuter backpack under a hundred and fifty dollars? Impo finds products and helps you compare. Explore photos, prices, and details, then open the merchant to buy.
Capture a thought with Echo on your phone. Come back to the transcript, and choose which speech is yours before it becomes personal context.
Impo brings useful memories into your next conversation. You can browse what it remembers and forget what you no longer want kept.
Give research, planning, or a first draft its own task. Work continues when you leave the app. Schedule recurring tasks, too.
Your Feed turns the context you share into useful next steps. A little perspective for the day ahead.
Connections and phone permissions are optional. The clients and backend are open source, so you can explore how Impo works.
Try Impo on the web or Android. iOS is in TestFlight, with public access pending. What can your personal agent help with today?
